hooks.command: osascript -e 'display notification "Claude があなたの入力を待っています" with title "Claude Code" sound name "Ping"'

statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd // empty'); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // empty'); used_pct=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); vim_mode=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.vim.mode // empty'); session_name=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.session_name // empty'); short_cwd="${cwd/#$HOME/~}"; git_branch=$(git -C "${cwd:-.}" symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || git -C "${cwd:-.}" rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); used_int=${used_pct%.*}; used_int=${used_int:-0}; filled=$(( used_int / 10 )); empty_bars=$(( 10 - filled )); bar=$(printf '█%.0s' $(seq 1 $filled 2>/dev/null))$(printf '░%.0s' $(seq 1 $empty_bars 2>/dev/null)); parts=""; sep=$(printf '\033[2m|\033[0m'); [ -n "$short_cwd" ] && parts="$(printf '\033[34m%s\033[0m' "$short_cwd")"; [ -n "$git_branch" ] && parts="$parts $sep $(printf '\033[32m%s\033[0m' "$git_branch")"; [ -n "$model" ] && parts="$parts $sep $(printf '\033[2m%s\033[0m' "$model")"; if [ -n "$used_pct" ]; then if [ "$used_int" -ge 90 ]; then ctx_color=31; elif [ "$used_int" -ge 70 ]; then ctx_color=33; else ctx_color=2; fi; parts="$parts $sep $(printf "\033[${ctx_color}mctx:${bar} ${used_int}%\033[0m")"; fi; [ -n "$vim_mode" ] && { [ "$vim_mode" = INSERT ] && vc=32 || vc=33; parts="$parts $sep $(printf "\033[${vc}m[${vim_mode}]\033[0m")"; }; [ -n "$session_name" ] && parts="$parts $sep $(printf '\033[2m\"%s\"\033[0m' "$session_name")"; printf '%s' "$parts"
